mask_field_meaning: mask=0 denotes DQ; mask=1 denotes INJ. This field is NOT 1<<bit.
bridge: O4 technical documentation explicitly equates O4a/O4b and 4 kHz/16 kHz flag semantics. Direct 4 kHz schema fetches via web tool failed; no local schema was inspected.
quality_groups: Category levels accumulate within each analysis group, not across CBC, BURST, CW and STOCH.

future_required_checks: Read and verify mask time origin, rate, length and exact shortname/bit dictionary for each detector.
Read and verify strain origin and sampling; reject fractional alignment not covered by registration.
Verify all intersecting seconds in both onsource and offsource windows; do not interpolate bitfields or fill missing time.
Reject missing flags, differing time origins, inconsistent coverage or unsupported releases.
time_contract.proposed_half_open_convention: DQ sample k covers [t_DQ0+k*Delta_DQ, t_DQ0+(k+1)*Delta_DQ). Map strain time t by floor((t-t_DQ0)/Delta_DQ). This interval convention is a proposed reader contract, not a claim of local verification.
time_contract.existing_reader_static_finding: strain_io.py checks integer masks, equal shape and length equal to strain duration; assumes mask origin meta/GPSstart and 1 Hz. It does not independently read mask cadence/origin attributes or validate the full dictionary against the published bit positions.

channel_scope: Public bulk-release source identity, not direct verification of local HDF5 attributes; GWF channel names are not HDF5 group paths.

calibration_release.O4a: C00 online, documented final public bulk product
calibration_release.O4b: AR01 is C01 where available and C00 otherwise; CLEAN includes noise subtraction.
calibration_release.reason_not_assigned: No new 14-GPS reconciliation or payload inspection in this unit.
